personality: Custom Fusion: 4 Tactile/Playful (bubbly shapes, sticker bomb composition) + 5 Brutalist (3px black outlines, hard offset shadows) + 7 Dark-First Utility (dark background).
personality_one_liner: A super-saturated, high-energy 'sticker bomb' aesthetic mimicking cartoon-network fan art and marker graffiti—featuring vivid flat fills, extremely thick black outlines, and hard offset shadows on a dark gritty background.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing to allow 'sticker' components to breathe and overlap slightly without clipping shadows.

shadow_tier: Custom Brutalist: hard offset only (width: 4, height: 4, blur: 0, opacity: 1, color: #000)

dont's: No blur, no translucency, no glass effects anywhere.
No gradients—all fills must be flat, saturated colors.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Hero entry point with massive graffiti energy and Google Sign-in.
screens.layout: Centered hero illustration (doodle collage), huge 'DeepCut Sports' wordmark in PermanentMarker or Bangers. Google Sign-in button acts as a massive primary action button (white fill, 3px black border, heavy black shadow, bottom third).

screens.name: Home / Quick Play
screens.purpose: Hub for selecting sports and launching quizzes.

states.empty: No sports loaded - comic-style sad mascot.

screens.layout: Grid of chunky 'Sticker Tiles' for each sport (vivid fills: #FF9F1C, #2EC4B6, etc., Bangers font). Match config opens as a heavy bottom sheet with thick black outline at the top. Background uses #1A1A1A dark gray to ensure black shadows are visible.

screens.name: Quiz Screen
screens.layout: Top: Live multiplayer scoreboard strip (stacked overlapping pills). Center: Timer circle (thick black stroke, BarlowCondensed numbers inside) + Question block (spray-painted frame or RubikSprayPaint accent). Bottom: 4 massive sticker buttons for answers, each a different vivid color, clicking down (shadow reduction) on press.

screens.name: Results & Leaderboards
screens.purpose: Show XP, tier ranks, and global standings.
screens.layout: Overlapping 'card' layout. Tier ranks (Casual, GOAT, etc.) represented by distinct colored badges with PermanentMarker typography. Leaderboard rows look like physical torn paper or stamped rows.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: User Avatar as a giant circle with thick outline. Username in Bangers. Tagline below in PermanentMarker. Stats grid uses brightly colored blocks pushed together. Achievements list runs horizontally like a collection of earned stickers.

dark_graffiti_bg.alt: Dark subtle graffiti texture for background layering

doodle_pattern.alt: Black and white abstract doodle pattern

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL AESTHETIC RULE: Push the 'sticker-bomb' and neo-brutalist cartoon look everywhere. All interactive elements (cards, buttons, tiles, bottom sheets) must have a thick black border (borderWidth: 3, borderColor: '#000000').

SHADOWS: Ditch standard blurred shadows. Use hard offset shadows exclusively: shadowColor: '#000000', shadowOffset: { width: 4, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 1, shadowRadius: 0. On Android, elevation alone will blur, so you may need to use a wrapper view or SVG for the hard shadow effect if elevation fails to look brutalist, or just rely on a slightly offset container underneath.

BACKGROUND: The base `surface` is dark gray (#1A1A1A), NOT pure black, so that the solid black shadows and outlines of the stickers can be seen. Do not use pure black backgrounds for screens where cards have black shadows.

TYPOGRAPHY MAPPING: Use 'Bangers' for all display titles, primary buttons, and headers. Use 'BarlowCondensed' for timers, scores, and large numbers. Use 'PermanentMarker' for taglines, user ranks, and secondary emphasis. Use 'RubikSprayPaint' sparingly for massive background watermarks or section breaks. Use 'IBMPlexSans' ONLY for readable body copy and small UI labels.

MICRO-INTERACTIONS: When a user presses a button, the button should translate/move down (+4px X, +4px Y) and the shadow should disappear, simulating a physical 'click' of the sticker against the background.

COLOR USAGE: Never use gradients. Always use flat, hyper-saturated fills. Randomize or cycle through the vivid colors (#FF0EA9, #FFC107, #FF9F1C, #2EC4B6, #9B5DE5, #06D6A0, #00B8FF, #EF476F) for list items, quiz answers, and badges so the screen looks like a colorful sticker collection.
OVERLAPPING: Encourage slight overlaps. In leaderboards or scoreboards, let profile avatars or rank badges slightly break out of their containers to feel like stickers slapped on top of each other.
